## Reporting Security Issues

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public issues,
discussions, or pull requests.

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting for this repository:

https://github.com/enka1504/useproof/security/advisories/new

Include as much of this as possible:

- Affected commit, branch, or release
- Affected source paths
- Reproduction steps
- Required configuration
- Proof-of-concept details, if safe to share privately
- Expected impact

Useproof inherits browser automation code from upstream. If the issue clearly
belongs to `browser-use/browser-use`, report it there as well through their
coordinated disclosure process.
